# Vendored Negative Result Warrant reference code

These files are copied **byte-for-byte** from the public `negative-result-warrant` release line used by this consumer witness.

Upstream repository: `risu-research/negative-result-warrant`
Upstream release: `v0.1.0-rc.1`
Upstream tagged commit: `7860c53c7763ec8b991ed3a2966e482eee331604`

The consumer intentionally reuses the released receiver/proposition/gate semantics rather than reimplementing them. `SOURCE-HASHES.sha256` binds every vendored TypeScript file in this directory.

The copied Phase 3 source keeps its historical relative import structure, which is why the frozen Phase 2.1 source tree is present here as well. No semantic edits are made to the vendored files.
